name: agentdeals
description: Search 1,600+ developer tool deals, compare vendors, check pricing stability, and estimate costs. Free tiers, startup credits, and promotional offers across 67 categories.
long_description:
AgentDeals indexes real, verified pricing data from 1,600+ developer infrastructure vendors across 67 categories. Search deals by keyword, category, or eligibility. Compare vendors side-by-side, check pricing stability and risk, estimate infrastructure costs, get full stack recommendations, and monitor pricing changes — all from within Claude Desktop.

Data is fetched from a hosted API (no local data needed). Tools cover the full lifecycle: discovery, comparison, risk assessment, cost estimation, and ongoing monitoring.

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Find free tiers, browse categories, get vendor details with alternatives. Filter by category, eligibility, or keyword.

tools.name: plan_stack
tools.description: Get stack recommendations, cost estimates, or a full infrastructure audit for your project.

tools.name: compare_vendors
tools.description: Compare 2 vendors side-by-side or check a single vendor's pricing risk.

tools.name: track_changes
tools.description: Track pricing changes, upcoming expirations, and new deals. Weekly digest with no params.

tools.name: get_referral_code
tools.description: Look up the referral link we hold for a vendor, with the conditions attached to it. We hold codes for a handful of vendors.
